name: Field Wrapper
summary: Control-agnostic field composition with a visible label, required canonical control slot, optional helper text, one current feedback message, and explicit association boundaries.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Vertical wrapper for a label, form control, and optional messages.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible label for the field control.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.description: Canonical composed form-control root; Field Wrapper does not copy or own its value behavior.

anatomy.name: description
anatomy.description: Helper text that describes expected input.

anatomy.name: feedback
anatomy.description: One current validation or confirmation message after the control and helper text.

anatomy.name: errorIcon
anatomy.description: Optional icon inside the error message.

anatomy.name: warning
anatomy.description: Field-level warning message for input that needs attention but remains valid.

variants.name: error
variants.description: Field wrapper associated with invalid input.

variants.name: success
variants.description: Field wrapper associated with validated input.

variants.name: warning
variants.description: Field wrapper associated with input that needs attention.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default field spacing and label size.

states.name: default
states.description: Label and canonical control are present with no current feedback.

states.name: withDescription
states.description: Optional helper text is present and referenced by the composed control.

states.name: withFeedback
states.description: One current feedback message is present and referenced by the composed control.

states.name: warning
states.description: Warning message is present without marking the control invalid.

behavior.name: labelAssociation
behavior.description: Every field wrapper should provide a visible label associated with its control or an equivalent accessible name.

behavior.name: messageAssociation
behavior.description: Helper text and the one current feedback message are programmatically associated with the composed control when present.

behavior.name: requiredState
behavior.description: Required visuals must stay synchronized with native or ARIA required state.

behavior.name: controlOwnership
behavior.description: The composed canonical control owns value, validity, events, disabled state, reset, and controlled/uncontrolled strategy; the wrapper owns only composition.

properties.name: control
properties.description: One canonical form-control root whose value and behavior remain independently owned.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Optional helper text placed after the control.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Feedback family used by the label and composed message.

properties.name: feedback
properties.description: One current feedback message; the selected variant determines its Error, Success, or Warning presentation.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Shows the visual required marker; consumers must synchronize the control's native required state.

accessibility: Pair every form control with a visible label whenever possible.
Use aria-describedby to connect the helper text and one current feedback message to the control.
Use aria-invalid="true" when the field has an error.
Do not expose aria-invalid for Success or Warning feedback.
Do not rely on the generated required marker as the only required-state signal.
Keep message order predictable: label, canonical control, helper text, then current feedback.
Do not copy the composed control's DOM, value state, validation logic, or runtime behavior into Field Wrapper.

web.notes: Implemented by the .field class family and a .field__control composition class in components/css/forms.css; no runtime or value owner is introduced.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render field wrappers with labels, native controls, and messages using the same class contract.
